clauses.quote: The District and the Association shall share equally in the payment for the services and expenses of the arbitrator.
clauses.notes: Joint cost-sharing duty; benefits both parties equally.

clauses.quote: All other expenses shall be borne by the party incurring them.
clauses.notes: Conditional cost allocation based on which party incurs the expense.

clauses.quote: The function of the arbitrator shall be to hold a hearing concerning the grievance and to render a written decision within twenty (20) duty days, if possible, after the closing of the hearing and, in any event, as soon as possible thereafter.
clauses.notes: Defines arbitrator's procedural duty to hold hearings and issue timely decisions.

clauses.quote: The arbitrator shall have no power to alter, amend, change, add to, or subtract from any of the terms of this Agreement or the written policies, rules, regulations and procedures of the District
clauses.notes: Restricts arbitrator's authority over contract and policy terms.

clauses.quote: shall determine only whether or not there has been a violation, misinterpretation, or misapplication of this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Limits arbitrator's scope to contract interpretation and dispute resolution.

clauses.quote: The arbitrator shall not be empowered to render a decision on issues not before the arbitrator or on facts not supported by the evidence.
clauses.notes: Restricts arbitrator jurisdiction to presented issues and supported evidence.

clauses.quote: The decision of the arbitrator shall be based solely upon the evidence and arguments presented by the parties in the presence of each other and upon arguments presented in briefs.
clauses.notes: Procedural requirement that arbitration awards rely exclusively on submitted evidence.

clauses.quote: Decisions and/or awards made by the arbitrator relative to economics shall be restricted to back pay, if appropriate, of the unit member
clauses.subject_text: Decisions and/or awards made by the arbitrator relative to economics
clauses.notes: Limits economic arbitration remedies to back pay only.

clauses.quote: shall not be retroactive beyond the beginning of the last payroll period prior to the filing of the grievance.
clauses.notes: Caps retroactive liability for back pay awards.

clauses.quote: The decision of the arbitrator, within the limits herein prescribed, shall be final and binding upon the grievant, the Association, and the District.
clauses.subject_text: The decision of the arbitrator, within the limits herein prescribed
clauses.notes: Establishes finality and binding effect of arbitration awards.

clauses.quote: No reprisals of any kind shall be taken by any party to this procedure against any party, any witness, any representative, or any other participant in the grievance procedure by reason of such participation.
clauses.notes: Anti-retaliation protection guarantees for all grievance procedure participants.
